basic_info.description: Prime Pacific Heights Location in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, 2632 Fillmore #1 boasts exquisite architectural detail, classic elegance and natural light throughout. This unit consists of 2 Bedrooms and 1.5 Baths. The floor plan includes an inviting living room with large windows and beautiful ceiling trim, formal large-scale dining room, two spacious bedrooms and one-half bathroom with Italian tile, single sink and shower over original Tub. Bright updated kitchen with pantry, ample cabinet space and stainless-steel appliances Viking Gas Range, granite counter tops, bamboo hardwood floors, recessed lighting.   Additional amenities include Washer and Dryer hook up in kitchen. 1 car tandem parking space (private entrance with electric garage door), private storage unit in garage, free laundry in the building.   SF living in one of the city's most coveted, charming neighborhoods: Fillmore Street, known for its trendy cafes, stylish boutiques, and upscale dining options. Walking distance to many shops and restaurants along Fillmore Street, public transportation and the iconic Lafayette Park and Alta Vista Park.
